claims: No. 2 seed Purdue defeated No. 7 seed Miami 79-69 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament second round on March 22, 2026.
Purdue advanced to their third straight Sweet 16.
The game was in St. Louis.
Purdue advances to face Texas in the West regional.
Purdue finished 21-of-22 from the free-throw line.
Miami hit 1-of-11 from three-point range in the second half
